title: Reading Practice Test 19 – Training & Education
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: quảng cáo khoá học, bản ghi nhớ, bài báo có chèn câu, lịch khoá học và e-mail). Chủ đề: đào tạo nội bộ, khoá học, cố vấn nghề nghiệp.

questions.content: The workshop is designed to help managers communicate more ------- with their teams.
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'communicate' → trạng từ; 'more effectively' (hiệu quả hơn).

questions.content: Participants ------- complete the course will receive a certificate.
questions.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ chỉ người, làm chủ ngữ cho 'complete' → 'who'.

questions.content: The training session has been postponed ------- further notice.
questions.explanation: Cụm cố định 'until further notice' = cho tới khi có thông báo mới.

questions.content: All new employees are required to attend a two-day ------- program.
questions.explanation: Danh từ ghép 'orientation program' = chương trình định hướng cho nhân viên mới.

questions.content: The instructor asked the trainees to work ------- in small groups.
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'work' → trạng từ 'collaboratively' (cộng tác).

questions.content: Ms. Chen has taught business English for ten years and ------- many textbooks.
questions.explanation: Song song với 'has taught' (hiện tại hoàn thành) → 'has written'.

questions.content: Online courses allow employees to study at ------- own pace.
questions.explanation: 'at one's own pace' = theo tốc độ của mình; trước 'own' dùng tính từ sở hữu → 'their'.

questions.content: Registration for the spring semester will open ------- March 1.
questions.explanation: Trước ngày cụ thể dùng 'on' → on March 1.

questions.content: The seminar was so popular that the organizers decided to hold ------- session next month.
questions.explanation: 'another + danh từ số ít' = thêm một (buổi) nữa.

questions.content: Employees ------- to attend the leadership program must be nominated by their managers.
questions.explanation: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động: Employees (who wish) → 'wishing'. Động từ chính là 'must be nominated'.

From: Laura Mendes, Training Coordinator
Subject: Negotiation Skills Workshop

Dear colleagues,

We are pleased to offer a two-day workshop on negotiation skills on April 14 and 15. The workshop ---131--- by Dr. Paul Okafor, a professor of business at Westfield University.

Participants will learn how to prepare for negotiations, handle difficult conversations, and reach agreements that benefit both sides. ---132---.

Space is limited to 20 participants. If you are interested, please ---133--- the online registration form by March 31. Priority will be given to employees who have joined the company ---134--- the past year.

Best regards,

questions.explanation: Hội thảo sẽ diễn ra (tháng Tư) và 'được dẫn dắt bởi' Dr. Okafor → bị động tương lai 'will be led'.

options.A: The sessions will include role-playing exercises based on real situations.
options.B: The company cafeteria is being renovated.
options.D: Parking is available behind the building.

questions.explanation: Đoạn mô tả nội dung hội thảo → câu chèn bổ sung hình thức học (đóng vai tình huống thực tế).
Sau 'please' dùng động từ nguyên mẫu (câu mệnh lệnh) → 'complete the form'.
'within the past year' = trong vòng một năm qua.

MEMO
To: All Employees
From: Human Resources
Date: January 8
Subject: New Mentoring Program

We are launching a mentoring program to help employees develop their careers. Each participant will be paired with an experienced colleague from a different department for six months.

Mentors and mentees will meet at least once a month to discuss goals, challenges, and opportunities for growth. Meetings can take place in person or by video call.

Employees who have worked here for at least one year may apply to be mentees. Those interested in becoming mentors must have at least five years of experience with the company. Applications are due by January 31.

questions.content: What is the purpose of the memo?

options.B: To request feedback on a policy
options.C: To announce a new development program

questions.explanation: 'We are launching a mentoring program to help employees develop their careers.'

questions.content: What is indicated about mentors and mentees?

options.C: They must work in the same department.
options.D: They will come from different departments.

questions.explanation: '…paired with an experienced colleague from a different department.' (A) sai – có thể họp qua video.

questions.content: Who is eligible to become a mentor?

options.A: Employees with at least five years at the company
options.D: Anyone who completes an application by February

questions.explanation: 'Those interested in becoming mentors must have at least five years of experience with the company.'

groups.passage:
Learning on the Go
By Priya Nair

Companies are increasingly turning to short online lessons, known as microlearning, to train their employees. [1] Instead of attending full-day workshops, workers watch five-minute videos or complete brief quizzes on their phones whenever they have time.

Supporters say microlearning fits better into busy schedules and helps people remember information. [2] A study by the Corporate Learning Institute found that employees who used microlearning retained 20 percent more information than those who attended traditional classes.

However, some experts caution that short lessons are not suitable for every subject. [3] Complex skills, such as leadership or project management, may still require longer training with opportunities for discussion. [4]

questions.content: What is the article mainly about?

options.A: A training method using short lessons

questions.explanation: Bài viết về microlearning – đào tạo bằng bài học ngắn trực tuyến.

questions.content: According to the study, what is an advantage of microlearning?
questions.explanation: Người học bằng microlearning 'retained 20 percent more information' → ghi nhớ tốt hơn.

questions.content: The word "caution" in paragraph 3, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'some experts caution that…' = một số chuyên gia cảnh báo rằng → warn.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"For this reason, many companies now combine both approaches."
questions.explanation: 'For this reason' kết luận từ ý kỹ năng phức tạp vẫn cần đào tạo dài → nhiều công ty kết hợp cả hai cách → vị trí [4].
